findings.description: The replay re-prices carried context as a fresh cache write when an actual automatic compaction is not taken under the replayed threshold. It should be a 0.1x cache read. This inflates the replayed spend at every threshold that skips a compaction.
findings.suggestion: carriedRead = step.idle || step.manualReset ? Math.min(call.read, carried) : carried;

findings.description: If no transcript in a class started inside the window and none had an auto compaction, the reset floor is `{read: 0, write: 0}`. Every replayed reset then costs nothing, which makes the lower thresholds look like large savings.
findings.body:
**The reset floor can be zero, which makes every replayed reset free.**

```ts
  const after = transcripts.flatMap(({ steps }) => steps.filter((s) => s.autoReset));
  const firsts = transcripts.flatMap(({ read, steps }) =>
    read.before || !steps[0] ? [] : [steps[0]],
  );
  const sample = after.length > 0 ? after : firsts;
  return {
    read: percentile(sample.map((s) => s.call.read), 0.5),
```

A transcript gets `read.before` set (`usage-report.service.ts:331`) when any of its calls predates `--since`, and `firsts` skips those transcripts. When no transcript in a class had an in-window auto compaction and all of them began before the window, `sample` is `[]`. `percentile([])` then returns 0 (`usage-report.service.ts:181-182`).

Nothing downstream guards against this. `statsOf` passes that floor into every `replayAt(threshold)`, and the `+Infinity` fallback only covers the observed-threshold row.

**Trigger:** a long conductor or console session that spans the `--since` boundary and holds more than 100k of context (for example `pup retro --since 1`).
- At each replayed reset at 100k/120k/150k, `carriedRead = rewrite = 0`, and the context restarts at that request's new tokens.
- The class row then prints a large negative `change`/`changeShare`.
- If the window holds only manual `/compact`s, or an auto compaction after the class's last request, `cheapestReplay` also puts "lower the compaction threshold" into the finding's fix text.

Options:
- Skip or mark the replay rows when the floor has no sample.
- Fall back to each transcript's first in-window request.

https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/d421540a5e5d643df7d958f234539acb8c19f0e6/src/core/retro-replay.service.ts#L169-L185

findings.description: The compaction count counts every compact_boundary, but the before/after medians only sample compactions followed by an in-window request. A class whose only compactions are the last entry of their transcripts (e.g. `/compact` then close) reports "N compactions, median context 0 tokens before and 0 after". Fall back to `preTokens` for a trailing boundary or omit the clause when nothing was sampled.

`contextStatsByClass` regroups the transcripts by class, but `classRows` has already done that grouping. Calling an exported `statsOf(items)` inside `classRows`' existing map would remove the second Map and the `as ContextStats` cast, which hides a lookup that could be undefined.

The `Step.compactedContext` comment says "the previous one's plus what came after it", but nothing is added. The code takes the compaction's `preTokens` and falls back to the previous request's context. Reword it the way ADR 0192 does: "the compaction's `preTokens`, else the previous request's context".
